nota: AI infrastructure worldwide, US included: AI data centres (Epoch AI tracker, automatic, all countries; Epoch GPU-cluster archive, automatic, only clusters with real coordinates and at least 1,000 H100e not already mapped; hand-curated campuses), data-centre hubs (metro clusters, not single sites), chip fabs and memory fabs, advanced packaging, equipment and material chokepoints (curated) and the top 50 TOP500 supercomputers (automatic). All coordinates are estimates: see origine_coord and precisione_km; systems or sites without a public position are not drawn and are listed in senza_posizione. mw = power as given by the source: Epoch = estimated IT power; TOP500 = consumption during the benchmark; hubs = metro market capacity; curated = see mw_tipo. importo = declared investment in billions of the currency; importo_usd_mld converted at fixed indicative rates. duplicato_ai_json = the point is also in ai.json (do not draw twice when both layers are on). Status of projects is often inferred from announcements: check data_fonte.
